title: 第41章 没有五公里治不好的感冒
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “啊欠！”“啊欠！”换衣服时，陆阳用力的打了两个喷嚏，脑瓜子都被震的嗡嗡响。孔垄见状，立马关心道：“班副，你咋了？”陆阳揉揉鼻子：“没事，鼻子有点不舒服。”“你不会是感冒了吧？”“应该不会吧？”陆阳抱着一丝侥幸心理说道。这时，周凯东走了过来，询问情况。“怎么了？”“陆阳好像感冒了，打了好几个喷嚏。”“可能是先前淋雨冻着了。”周凯东从柜子里拿出一包板蓝根冲剂。“待会把他喝了，在宿舍歇一会。”“没事儿班长，就是有点儿鼻塞，不耽误训练的。。”“真没事儿？”“真的。”陆阳笑着说：“部队里不都说，没有一个五公里治不好的感冒，如果有那就再来一个五公里吗？正好天气冷，活动活动还能暖和点。”周凯东看他状态还算不错，于是便点点头：“那你先把冲剂喝了，待会儿跟着练，感觉状态不对了就停下，知不知道？”“是！”陆阳挺起胸膛敬了个礼。但周凯东和孔垄却再用一副非常奇怪的表情盯着他。陆阳这才反应过来，是两行晶莹剔透的水晶吊坠，从鼻孔里流了下来。他赶紧用面纸给擦了，然后用暖水壶里的热水，冲了一杯板蓝根。喝下去的瞬间，陆阳再次出现毛孔大开的舒适感，连堵塞的鼻子都透气许多。可紧跟着，他便再次冷的缩了缩脖子，像是衣服突然大了一号变得不再贴身，保暖性也差了点儿。【系统友情提示：宿主已经感冒，并伴随37.1的低烧，应适当休息，保证充足睡眠......】陆阳将面板叉掉，选择性的无视。你能有我懂感冒？久病成良医。陆阳从小就是各大诊所医院的常客。所以寻常感冒在他这里，就跟吃饭睡觉一样稀松平常。前世的陆阳为了生计送过外卖，跑过滴滴，做过代驾。感冒头疼活儿就不干了，开什么玩笑，不然能叫牛马打工人？尤其是当模子哥那阵有回发烧，反倒意外获得用户反馈的一致好评......陆阳原以为经过这段时间锻炼，身体素质已经得到增强，应该没那么容易着凉感冒才对。现在看来，还是不够理想，那就更得加把劲了！部队是头疼脑热是再正常不过的一件事，绝大多数战士都得努力克服。不然也不会流传出：没有一个感冒，是五公里治不好的这句话。陆阳作为副班长，得起到一定的带头表率。旁人都在辛苦训练，他却端着茶杯像个老干部似的坐在宿舍里休息，不得被人把脊梁骨都戳烂了？所以陆阳并未将此放在心上，而是在喝完板蓝根后直接就跟着大伙儿来到走廊上搞体能。外头的雨还在下，虽然不算大，但淅淅沥沥的就没停过。训练场上空荡荡，一个人都没有，全连新兵都在宿舍楼内的各个地方开展体能训练。新兵连始建于八九十年代，范围并不大，各项设施都比较老旧，压根就没有室内训练场这么一说。但不能因为下雨了就懈怠下来，于是在宿舍楼内训练，便成了个好办法。虽说楼内空间有限，但站军姿，做深蹲，做个俯卧撑，高抬腿什么的，还是没问题的。这会儿，楼上传来有节奏的跳跃声，十有八九是正在组织蛙跳训练，震的楼板咚咚响。“原计划，是要带着大家学习新科目——战术训练，但因为下雨原因只能延后。”“考虑到目前三公里跑，班上仍有部分人成绩不达标，所以上午训练主要还是体能。”“跑步踏步走，看我做示范；121,121,1234......”周凯东讲简单活动了一下腿部关节，做了个肌肉拉伸。这项训练十分虐腿，这么做也是为了避免肌肉拉伤。动作和原地高抬腿跑类似，但却加了摆动手臂的动作。不知道为什么，从背后看过去总觉得有那么些似曾相识的滑稽感。陆阳想起来了，星爷电影里唐伯虎卖身葬父混入华府，成为低等下人9527时，就是这个跑步姿势。许是有不少人都看过这部电影，在周凯东做示范时，竟有两个新兵没忍住噗呲一声笑了出来。“立定！”周凯东右脚跺地，立定站好后身体后转。先前那俩笑出声的赶紧收敛笑容，生怕待会帽子就砸过来了。但周凯东却只是看了他们一眼，不痛不痒的说了句注意队列纪律，然后就下达了训练要求。“五分钟一组，先来五组热热身，开始。”话音落下，新兵们全员开始有样学样的跑步踏步走。这个动作，看着没什么难度，但跑起来还是挺酸爽的。因为道理和高抬腿类似，所以没跑一会儿便气喘吁吁，大腿疼的厉害。陆阳同样跑的满头是汗，感觉身上暖和和的，鼻塞都变得通畅了许多。要不都说生命在于运动，适当锻炼确实能够强身健体，缓解不适。“感觉怎么样？”“发发汗，感觉好多了。”陆阳脸红扑扑的，笑着回应班长。感冒在部队里不算大事，周凯东以前也中过招。基本都是一包板蓝根，两颗感冒药就能搞定的事儿。所以在确认陆阳身体并无大碍后，稍作休整后便来到下一个训练项目，撑拳俯卧撑。按照他以往的性格，应该是找张报纸让新兵蛋子们滴湿才对，但考虑到天气太冷，这项训练实在不合适。便让大家把被子从宿舍床上抱出来铺在地上，拳头撑在上头，这样能够有效保护手指关节。“1上2下，先来一百个！”“1......”作为常规俯卧撑的进阶版，系统慷慨的给予两倍收益加速。陆阳自然不愿意错过这样的机会，所以做的十分认真。他的身体绷的很紧，每个动作都在严格要求自已。但不知道为什么，今回的俯卧撑，似乎比以往任何时候都要吃力。除此之外，陆阳还觉得脑袋有些发沉，像是戴着一顶铅做的帽子，喉咙里还莫名有些发痒。因为这组还没结束，陆阳担心咳出来会卸掉身体里那口气，便死死抿着嘴。将这股喉咙须痒的感觉给硬生生憋住，直到这组全部做完。“咳咳，咳咳咳！”停下瞬间，陆阳开始剧烈咳嗽。震动缓解喉咙的须痒，带来舒适感。忽的外头一阵狂风吹来，卷着屋檐上滑落的雨滴，打在了陆阳的下巴上。突如其来的刺激，直接让他浑身打了个冷颤，像是瞬间来到了冰窖里。孔垄见他脸色不对，关心道：“陆阳，你咳的有点儿厉害啊，该不会真感冒了吧？”陆阳心虚的摇头：“应该不会吧？可能是喉咙有点儿干，喝点水就好了......”刚说完，周凯东就上来用手背摸了摸他的额头，然后又摸了摸自已的，随即皱起眉头。“好像有点儿烫？”“我看看！”孔垄直接抓着陆阳的脑袋，把自已脑袋怼了上去。脑袋贴脑袋，是最能直观感受温度变化。在他们老家，都这么干。“坏了，好像发烧了。”“不是吧？”陆阳原本还想嘴硬，可看着温度计上37.3的数字，整个人都不好了。昏昏沉沉的感觉如潮水般袭来，眼皮开始不断打架，身体也缓缓倾倒在了床铺上。落下瞬间，像是砸在棉花里，又像是落在水里，起起伏伏，摇摇晃晃。接着整个身体，都有种被人绑在单杠上，不用转圈圈的失重感。......“多少？”“38.2了？”“上午还37.5呢？”“这退烧药不起作用啊！”下午，三班新兵围在陆阳床铺前。何镇涛坐在床边，甩了甩手里的温度计。看着床上因为发烧昏睡过去的陆阳，脸色实在有些难看。他用手在陆阳脑袋上摸了摸，滚烫滚烫的，像个发热的小暖炉。何镇涛帮着把被子往里掖了掖，又给封了一床在上头，这才寒着脸站起身。“一排长，你跟我出来一下！！”周凯东看了眼床上躺着的陆阳，内心五味杂陈，也跟了出去......
content_en: "Ah owe!" "Ah owe!" While changing clothes, Lu Yang sneezed twice so hard that his head was shaken and buzzing.Upon seeing this, Kong Long immediately asked with concern: "Deputy deputy, what's wrong with you?" Lu Yang rubbed his nose: "It's okay, my nose is a little uncomfortable." "You don't have a cold, do you?" "It shouldn't happen, right?" Lu Yang said with a hint of luck.At this time, Zhou Kaidong came over and asked about the situation."What's wrong?" "Lu Yang seems to have caught a cold and sneezed several times." "Maybe he was frozen in the rain earlier." Zhou Kaidong took out a pack of Banlangen granules from the cabinet."Drink him later and rest in the dormitory for a while." "It's okay, squad leader. I just have a little stuffy nose. It won't delay the training..." "Is it really okay?" "Really." Lu Yang said with a smile: "Don't they all say in the army that there is no cold that cannot be cured within five kilometers? If there is, then there will be another one.Five kilometers?It happens to be cold and the activity can be warmer." Zhou Kaidong saw that he was in good condition, so he nodded: "Then drink the medicine first and then stop if you feel the condition is not right." "Yes!" Lu Yang raised his chest and saluted.But Zhou Kaidong and Kong Long stared at him again with very strange expressions.Only then did Lu Yang realize that two rows of crystal clear crystal pendants were flowing down from his nostrils.He quickly wiped it with tissue paper, and then used the hot water in the kettle to make a cup of isatis root.The moment he drank it, Lu Yang felt comfortable again with his pores wide open, and even his clogged nose became much more breathable.But immediately afterwards, he shrank his neck in coldness again, as if his clothes were suddenly a size too big and no longer fit him tightly, and the warmth was no longer the same.[Friendly reminder from the system: The host has caught a cold and is accompanied by a low fever of 37.1. He should take appropriate rest and ensure adequate sleep...] Lu Yang crossed out the panel and selectively ignored it.Can you understand colds like me?A long-term illness makes a good doctor.Lu Yang has been a frequent visitor to major clinics and hospitals since he was a child.So the common cold is as common to him as eating and sleeping.In his previous life, Lu Yang delivered food, worked for Didi, and worked as a driver for a living.You have to stop working if you have a cold and a headache. Are you kidding me? Otherwise, you can ask cows and horses to beat the workers?Especially when the model brother had a fever, he unexpectedly received unanimous praise from user feedback... Lu Yang originally thought that after this period of exercise, his physical fitness had been improved and he should not be so prone to colds.Now it seems that it is still not ideal, so we need to work harder!It is normal for troops to have headaches and fever, and most soldiers have to work hard to overcome it.Otherwise, the saying would not spread: No cold can be cured by traveling five kilometers.As the deputy squad leader, Lu Yang must set a certain example.Everyone else is training hard, but he is sitting in the dormitory to rest like a veteran with a teacup in his hand. How can he not have his spine broken?So Lu Yang didn't take this to heart, but after drinking isatis root, he followed everyone to the corridor to do some physical exercise.It was still raining outside, although it wasn't heavy, but it didn't stop.The training ground was empty, there was no one, and all the recruits were conducting physical training in various places in the dormitory building.The recruit company was built in the 1980s and 1990s. It is not large in scope and all facilities are relatively old. There is no indoor training ground at all.But we can't slack off just because it rains, so training in the dormitory building becomes a good idea.Although the space in the building is limited, it is still no problem to stand in a military posture, do squats, push-ups, raise your legs, etc.At this moment, there was a rhythmic sound of jumping upstairs. It was most likely that frog jumping training was being organized, and the floorboards were shaking."The original plan was to take everyone to learn a new subject - tactical training, but it had to be postponed because of the rain." "Considering that some people in the class are still not up to standard in the current three-kilometer run, the morning training is mainly about physical fitness." "Running and walking, watch me demonstrate; 121, 121, 1234..." Zhou Kaidong briefly moved his leg joints and stretched his muscles.This training is very tough on the legs, and it is also done to avoid muscle strain.The action is similar to running with your legs raised in place, but with the addition of arm swinging.I don’t know why, but when I look at it from behind, I always feel that there is something funny about déjà vu.Lu Yang remembered that in the movie Star Master, Tang Bohu sold himself, buried his father, and infiltrated Washington and became a low-class servant, 9527, with this running posture.Perhaps many people have watched this movie. When Zhou Kaidong was demonstrating, two recruits couldn't help but burst out laughing."Stand still!" Zhou Kaidong stamped his right foot on the ground, stood still and turned his body back.The two who laughed out loud before quickly suppressed their smiles, fearing that their hats would be thrown at them later.But Zhou Kaidong just glanced at them, said calmly to pay attention to queue discipline, and then issued training requirements."One group of five minutes, let's do five groups to warm up first, let's start." After the words fell, all the recruits began to run and walk in the same pattern.This movement doesn't look difficult, but it's still quite refreshing when running.Because the principle is similar to raising the legs high, I was out of breath after running for a while and my thighs hurt terribly.Lu Yang was also sweating from running. His body felt warm and his nasal congestion became much clearer.It is said that life lies in exercise. Proper exercise can indeed strengthen the body and relieve discomfort."How do you feel?" "I'm sweating, I feel much better." Lu Yang blushed and responded to the monitor with a smile.Colds are not a big deal in the army, and Zhou Kaidong has suffered from them before.Basically, a pack of isatis root and two cold medicines can do the job.So after confirming that Lu Yang was fine, he took a short rest and then moved on to the next training item, push-ups with fists.According to his past personality, he should find a newspaper to wet the recruits' balls, but considering that the weather is too cold, this training is really not suitable.Then everyone was asked to take out the quilts from the dormitory beds and spread them on the ground, with their fists on top. This could effectively protect the finger joints."1 up, 2 down, a hundred first!" "1..." As an advanced version of regular push-ups, the system generously gives twice the income acceleration.Lu Yang was naturally unwilling to miss such an opportunity, so he did it very seriously.His body was very tight, and every movement he made was strictly demanding on himself.But I don’t know why, but this time the push-ups seemed to be more difficult than ever.In addition, Lu Yang also felt that his head was a little heavy, as if he was wearing a lead hat, and his throat was inexplicably itchy.Because the group was not over yet, Lu Yang was worried that coughing would remove the breath from his body, so he pursed his lips tightly.I suppressed the itchy feeling in my throat until the entire set was completed."Cough, cough, cough!" The moment he stopped, Lu Yang began to cough violently.The vibration relieves throat itch and brings comfort.Suddenly, a strong wind blew from outside, picking up the raindrops sliding down the eaves and hitting Lu Yang on the chin.The sudden stimulation made him shiver all over, as if he had been in an ice cellar instantly.Seeing that his expression was wrong, Kong Long asked with concern: "Lu Yang, you're coughing a bit badly. Could it be that you really have a cold?" Lu Yang shook his head guiltily: "Maybe not? Maybe his throat is a little dry, just drink some water..." As soon as he finished speaking, Zhou Kaidong came up and touched his forehead with the back of his hand, and then touched his own, and then frowned."It seems a little hot?" "Let me see!" Kong Long directly grabbed Lu Yang's head and pushed his own head up.Putting your head against your head is the most intuitive way to feel the temperature changes.In their hometown, they all do this."It's broken. It seems that I have a fever." "Isn't it right?" Lu Yang originally wanted to be harsh, but when he saw the number 37.3 on the thermometer, he felt bad.The feeling of drowsiness came over him like a tide, his eyelids began to fight, and his body slowly fell onto the bed.The moment it fell, it felt like it was smashed into cotton, or like falling into water, rising and falling, swaying.Then the whole body felt weightless like being tied to a horizontal bar without having to turn around in circles...."How much?" "38.2?" "It was still 37.5 in the morning?" "This antipyretic medicine doesn't work!" In the afternoon, the third class of recruits gathered in front of Lu Yang's bed.He Zhentao sat on the edge of the bed and shook the thermometer in his hand.Looking at Lu Yang who was sleeping on the bed due to fever, his expression was really ugly.He touched Lu Yang's head with his hand. It was hot, like a small heater.He Zhentao helped tuck in the quilt and put a bed on top, then stood up with a cold face."Platoon leader, come out with me!!" Zhou Kaidong glanced at Lu Yang lying on the bed, with mixed feelings in his heart, and followed him out...
